comment: Written against OpenCode 2.0.20 (native TUI on the alternate screen) from live sessions recorded in a pty against an OpenAI-compatible LM Studio endpoint, with edit and shell permissions set to ask; must be re-verified when OpenCode changes its TUI. The permission box ('△ Permission required' with the 'Allow once   Always allow   Reject' choices and the '⇆ select  enter confirm' hint) is BLOCKED; the progress-bar footer ('■■⬝⬝⬝⬝⬝⬝ esc interrupt') shown while a turn runs is WORKING; the prompt box closed by its '╹▀▀▀' border with the 'ctrl+p commands' footer is IDLE. The prompt box stays visible while OpenCode works, so the idle rule vetoes on 'esc interrupt' and 'Permission required' and has the lowest priority; the approval rule anchors its patterns to the start of a line (after the box border), because a transcript that quotes the dialog text must not read as a pending permission. No rule depends on the alternate-screen flag.
